stem: Source-water EC has increased substantially from the facility's recent baseline. Why should the technician record and escalate the change?
choices: Because source-water changes can affect interpretation of the prepared nutrient solution and root-zone trends
Because source EC directly identifies the missing nutrient
Because any source-water change proves contamination
Because feed measurements are no longer needed
rationale: A changed source-water ionic baseline can influence prepared-solution comparisons and should remain visible in the data context without being overinterpreted as a specific chemistry diagnosis.
